name: OmniJev
notes: The repository holds adapter_model.safetensors, decision and ordinal heads, added-token embeddings, tokenizer and processor files, result reports and release_manifest.json with SHA-256 checksums; the Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B backbone is downloaded separately and inference runs through the OmniJev GitHub code. The card reports per-family accuracy over 30 families, including androidcontrol, pilot_web, point_phone and web. Apache-2.0 covers the adapter and project code.
summary: OmniJev v1.1 is a 4B LoRA adapter with decision heads for Qwen3.5-4B that answers typed questions about screens and other images with probabilities; its task families include androidcontrol and web.
